subject: POC trial plan + final readout scheduling — Aurora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial plan follow-up and success criteria (recap)

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation. As promised, here’s a concise recap and proposed plan for the POC/trial so we’re all aligned. Please flag any missing items or changes.

Goal
- Validate Redwood Inference can meet Aurora Health’s throughput and latency SLOs for clinical note summarization and ensure outputs meet QA thresholds for accuracy and safety.

Success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: median token latency <= 120ms for 2–3k token requests under expected load.
- Throughput: sustain 20 qps for batch inference tests across two replica pools.
- Quality: ROUGE-L baseline >= 0.72 on the provided gold set; no critical hallucinations on spot checks.
- Security/compliance: end-to-end encryption of in-transit data, logging/audit enabled, SOC2 controls documented.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): Share test dataset and evaluation template (attached: Evaluation_Criteria_sheet.xlsx).
- Week 1: Redwood spins up dedicated trial capacity in our staging region; run smoke tests.
- Week 2: Full evaluation runs (latency and throughput); QA team review outputs.
- Week 3: Final readout + exec decision meeting (go/no-go).

Ownership
- Aurora: Lisa (technical lead), Tom (product/exec sponsor) — provide dataset access, evaluation contacts, and decision timeline.
- Redwood: Marcus (technical implementation), Rishi (SLA & pricing liaison), me (project owner / readout).

Notes / asks
- Please confirm the dataset delivery date and whether Aurora needs a dedicated VPC or if staging credentials (TLS + KMS) suffice.
- If the exec review needs to be on a particular day, share availability; I’ve tentatively proposed June 22–24 for the final readout.

Attachments referenced: Aurora_POCTemplate_v3.pdf, Evaluation_Criteria_sheet.xlsx, Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf

Next steps
- Lisa: confirm dataset delivery and security preference by EOD Friday.
- Marcus: will provision trial infra by Monday and share access notes.
- Rishi: draft potential pricing/term note for post-POC stage.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial plan follow-up and success criteria (recap)

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful. Quick answers:

- Dataset: We can deliver the de-identified clinical notes set by Tuesday (2026-06-08). I’ll share an S3 bucket + access policy.
- Security: For the trial we prefer a dedicated VPC endpoint with customer-managed KMS if possible; we can do staging creds only if VPC isn’t available within your timeline.
- Exec timing: Tom is available the week of June 22 for a 30–45 min readout; internal steering committee is meeting June 23 AM PT — that would be ideal for alignment.

One question: for the quality checks, can Redwood provide a quick template for the hallucination spot-check process so our QA knows what to look for?

Also looping in Tom — he’ll confirm exec availability next week.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Chen
Director, Clinical AI, Aurora Health
lisa.chen@aurorahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial plan follow-up and success criteria (recap)

Thanks — quick tech update.

- I’ll provision a dedicated trial pool in us-west-2 with two replicas and the recommended kernel selection for the 7B quantized variant unless you request a different model.
- VPC endpoint + customer KMS: we can support this for the trial. We’ll need the subnet/cidr and KMS ARN; Marcus@redwood will coordinate with your infra team. (Marcus -> note: collect VPC details after Lisa confirms.)
- Hallucination spot-check template: attaching a short checklist and sample script for randomized spot checks. I’ve also added a column in the Evaluation_Criteria_sheet for manual QA notes.

I’ll share access instructions and an initial smoke test report by Monday EOD.

– Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: POC trial plan follow-up and success criteria (recap) — final readout scheduling + decision process

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks for the confirmations. Per Marcus we can support VPC + customer KMS; Marcus will follow up on technical details.

Final readout (proposed)- Date: June 23, 2026- Time: 09:00–09:45 AM PT- Attendees: Tom (exec sponsor), Lisa (tech lead), Aurora QA, Marcus (Redwood infra), Rishi (Redwood pricing), me (Redwood project owner)

Readout agenda (30–40 min)- 5 min: recap objectives & success criteria- 10 min: ops & performance results (latency/throughput) — Marcus- 10 min: quality & QA findings (sample outputs, hallucination spot-check) — Aurora QA + Redwood- 5–10 min: decision & next steps (exec go/no-go, contracting path if go)

Decision process & next contract steps (proposal)- If execs sign off (go): Redwood provides a 60-day commercial offer window; Rishi will send a redline-friendly term sheet and pricing options within 48 hours of decision.- If execs request follow-up work (partial go): agree on remediation items, timeline (2 weeks typical), and an updated readout.- If no-go: retro notes and compile learnings.

Please let me know if June 23 works for you and who will present QA findings. Once confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite and a short readout deck template.

Thanks — looking forward to the readout.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
